This section does four things, in order. They are worth doing in that order the first time.
1. Decide the decay.
Older weeks contribute fewer images, so a model retrained every week does not drift towards its own history. Off, every week counts in full. Nothing is ever deleted -- the week folders stay whole and only the training set is thinned.
